subject.title: Telegram detached subagents can run silently without liveness or terminal notification

question: Should this remain a Telegram-specific liveness and terminal-delivery slice, or be folded into the broader session activity and owner-session completion-delivery work before implementation?
rationale: The fix crosses Telegram transport UX, subagent/task state, completion handoff, possible configuration, and several open partial items, so automation should not choose the public delivery policy or API boundary alone.

options.title: Keep Telegram Slice
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical Telegram-visible contract and let generic activity or completion PRs feed it as dependencies.

options.title: Fold Into Generic Activity
options.body: Move the Telegram evidence into the broader session activity and watchdog issues, then close this only after that work explicitly owns Telegram delivery.

options.title: Wait For Terminal PR
options.body: Defer liveness policy until the owner-session completion PR lands or is closed, then reassess the remaining Telegram-only gap.

recommendation.title: Keep Telegram Slice
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical Telegram-visible contract and let generic activity or completion PRs feed it as dependencies.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the core task/subagent state and delivery boundary where steipete has the strongest recent routing history among the inspected files.
